tepper is the man but to me, he just shines a light on other guys (Druck, PTJ) as "the man" for their contributions to the game, willingness to share their secret sauce, do tons of intvws, stay humble

tepper keeps a low pro and he's obviously entitled to, I can't say shit

but over the past few decades you don't get much from him except an occasional "I'm 400% long Chinese Internet stocks"

never opens the kimono to us young cats like the others do, even SAC, in explaining like "this is how I make my bread"...there's always some tips and tricks in there, like, there's no doubt you are an all-time talented trader

but w/e. he's still the man, it just has to make you more grateful for someone like Druck who despite having a pretty opaque process, still has put out a vast amount of intvw material for the rest of us to [attempt] to soak up
